locator: I-II q.94 a.5 ad 1: lex naturae in aliquorum cordibus, quantum ad aliqua, corrupta erat intantum ut existimarent esse bona quae naturaliter sunt mala; et talis corruptio correctione indigebat
interpretation: The written law was given to correct the law of nature in this sense: in some hearts, in some respects, the natural law was so corrupted that they thought good what is naturally evil, and that corruption needed correction. Read as the Catholic answer to Q-MORAL-PROGRESS: a change of moral view can be the correction of an error.
